/programs/private-pilot.heading: Private Pilot
/programs/private-pilot.copy: Build the foundation for every rating that follows with concentrated ground and flight instruction.

/programs/instrument-rating.heading: Instrument Rating
/programs/instrument-rating.copy: Develop the skills and judgment to operate safely by reference to instruments.

/programs/commercial-single-engine.heading: Commercial Single-Engine
/programs/commercial-single-engine.copy: Advance your flying to commercial standards through concentrated maneuver, ground, and practical-test preparation.

/programs/commercial-multi-engine.heading: Commercial Multi-Engine
/programs/commercial-multi-engine.copy: Train for commercial multi-engine privileges in Lakes Area Aviation’s Piper Apache.

/programs/cfi-cfii.heading: CFI & CFII
/programs/cfi-cfii.copy: Choose an accelerated initial flight-instructor course, add instrument-instructor privileges, or plan both ratings back to back.

/programs/mei.heading: Multi-Engine Instructor
/programs/mei.copy: Add multi-engine instructor privileges in the Piper Apache through a short, concentrated course.

/programs/zero-to-hero.heading: Zero to Hero
/programs/zero-to-hero.copy: See the complete sequence Lakes Area Aviation publishes for progressing from no flight time toward professional flying.

/specialized-training/kodiak-100.heading: Kodiak 100 Training
/specialized-training/kodiak-100.copy: The Kodiak 100 is a single-engine turboprop utility airplane built for short, rough fields. We are an approved initial and recurrent training provider with most insurance companies.

/specialized-training/tailwheel.heading: Tailwheel Endorsement
/specialized-training/tailwheel.copy: A logbook endorsement required to act as pilot in command of a tailwheel airplane (14 CFR 61.31(i)).

/specialized-training/complex.heading: Complex Endorsement
/specialized-training/complex.copy: Required to act as pilot in command of a complex airplane: retractable landing gear, flaps and a controllable-pitch propeller (14 CFR 61.31(e)).

/specialized-training/high-performance.heading: High-Performance Endorsement
/specialized-training/high-performance.copy: Required to act as pilot in command of an airplane with an engine of more than 200 horsepower (14 CFR 61.31(f)).

/specialized-training/high-altitude.heading: High-Altitude Endorsement
/specialized-training/high-altitude.copy: Required to act as pilot in command of a pressurized airplane with a service ceiling or maximum operating altitude above 25,000 ft MSL (14 CFR 61.31(g)).

/specialized-training/spin-training.heading: Spin Training
/specialized-training/spin-training.copy: Stall and spin awareness, spin entry and recovery. Flight instructor applicants need this endorsement before the CFI checkride (14 CFR 61.183(i)).

/specialized-training/mountain-flying.heading: Mountain Flying Course
/specialized-training/mountain-flying.copy: Fly safely in and around high terrain, taught from Platte Valley Airpark (18V) at a field elevation of 4,965 ft.

/specialized-training/light-aerobatics.heading: Light Aerobatics Course
/specialized-training/light-aerobatics.copy: An introduction to basic aerobatic maneuvers that builds confidence and control at unusual attitudes.

/specialized-training/ski-plane.heading: Ski Plane Training
/specialized-training/ski-plane.copy: Learn to fly a ski-equipped airplane from snow and frozen lakes during a Minnesota winter.

/specialized-training/cirrus-transition.heading: Cirrus Transition Training
/specialized-training/cirrus-transition.copy: Transition training for pilots moving into a Cirrus SR20 or SR22: its systems, avionics and the Cirrus Airframe Parachute System (CAPS).
